title: OfficeCLI lets your AI build every PowerPoint, Word doc, and sheet
description:
https://github.com/iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI

OfficeCLI is a free, open-source Office suite built for AI agents. It gives any AI full control to read, edit, and create Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files from one single binary, no Office install needed. Its built-in rendering engine turns documents into pictures so your AI can look at its own work and fix mistakes. Describe what you want and let the agent build it.
